skill.displayName: AI Ghibli Art Create – Turn Photos into Anime Art Online – API-powered
skill.summary: AI Ghibli art creator — transform any photo into Studio Ghibli anime art style

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ghibli-art-create-openapi-skill.
- Transforms any photo into Studio Ghibli anime art style using WeShop OpenAPI.
- Requires a WeShop API key (WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable); secure handling enforced.
- Supports photo upload, run status polling, and custom style instructions.
- Generate up to 16 Ghibli-style images per request.
